Thanks to the integrated insulating underlay, impact noise is reduced by up to 21 dB, improving acoustic comfort in every space

The matte and textured finish gives the product an authentic look and an extremely natural feel, making the floor a distinctive element in any environment

Numerous decors are available, offering endless possibilities to personalize spaces according to your style

title: Rovere Perla
description:
OMNIA Standard Plank features elegant formats, matte authentic surfaces, and reliable performance thanks to a stable click system and integrated underlay

The planks in the OMNIA Standard Plank line stand out for their elegant format, which enhances the decor and the matte, authentic vinyl surface, giving the floor an even more natural look. The lacquered 4V groove along the entire perimeter highlights each plank, creating a visual effect that expands the space

Thanks to the practical click system, simple and stable, and usage class 34, this floor is ideal for tackling daily challenges with style and resistance. Additionally, the integrated underlay improves room acoustics and walking comfort

The special plank dimensions give the floor a unique and welcoming elegance. The combination of format, structure, and decor enhances every detail, making it a refined choice for any space

description:

The Deep Brushed structure gives each plank an authentic and tactile texture, while the UV finish ensures resistance and durability over time

Available in various wood-inspired decors, JANGAL Straw Floor is the ideal choice for those seeking an ecological floor without sacrificing elegance and practicality

title: Concrete Stone
description:
OMNIA Standard Tiles XL are large-format SPC tiles with stone or marble effect, designed for stability, acoustic comfort, and modern interiors

The Omnia Standard Tile XL collection combines modern design with maximum functionality. The 470x830 mm format enhances spaces with clean, elegant lines, while stone or marble effect surfaces deliver a contemporary and versatile look

Made of SPC with a Rigid Core backing, they ensure high stability, excellent wear resistance, total waterproofing, and superior acoustic comfort thanks to the integrated IXPE underlay

Safe and healthy, they are phthalate-free, with VOCs and formaldehyde not detected. Ideal for residential and commercial environments, they bring together style, technology, and practicality in a single solution
